digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend implementation and configuration
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend does not satisfy the Backend @runtime_checkable Protocol because it lacks query_project and assert_env_ready members, causing isinstance checks to fail despite successful registration
The DC backend is registered via @register('jira-datacenter') but unreachable via config because reconciler.backend validation still restricts choices to {'jira'} only

Inbound assignee identity minting for DC deployments fails silently because accountId is absent in DC user objects, so the guard in _ensure_inbound_assignee_identity returns early and never attempts the mint

The obvious fix to DC identity minting (accepting name/key instead of accountId) would trigger a latent ValueError due to 'jira-datacenter' not being in CREATION_CHANNELS, and that exception would be silently swallowed at DEBUG level

A writing pass against a real Jira DC instance crashes with 'set_entity_property' attribute missing because the TicketTransport Protocol does not declare this method despite the core calling it from three sites
